content.comment_body: I'm trying to read the initial value from an analog input using the [product_name] expansion module. I only want to capture and save the first analog value obtained during the initial controller cycle. For now, I'm not concerned about subsequent analog values. I attempted to use the MOV_BIR block (Move Byte Immediate Read), but this led to an error.
This thread is closed because the same question has been posted in another discussion: 'How to save the initial analog input value into a variable.'

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to obtain and store only the very first analog input value from the [product_name] expansion module during controller startup. Attempts to use the MOV_BIR function block have resulted in errors, which suggests that this procedure may lack clear documentation or may not be straightforward, making it challenging for users to implement initial value sampling and reliable variable storage.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for a simple and dependable solution to capture and store the first analog value from an input module at controller startup, without encountering errors.
